units.source_text: 我对那只哭泣不止的雌河童很是同情，就轻扶着她的肩膀，把她带到屋角的躺椅那儿。

en.t: I felt great sympathy for the female kappa who would not stop crying, so I gently supported her by the shoulder and led her to the reclining chair in the corner of the room.

units.source_text: 一只那儿还有一只两三岁的河童天真无邪地笑着。

en.t: There was also a two- or three-year-old kappa there, smiling innocently.

units.source_text: 我就替雌河童哄了哄河童娃娃。

en.t: So I soothed the little kappa child in place of the female kappa.

units.source_text: 我感到自己也泪流满面了。

en.t: I realized that my own face was wet with tears as well.

units.source_text: 我在河童国居住的日子了，也就只哭过这么一回。

en.t: In all the days I lived in the land of the kappa, that was the only time I ever cried.
